items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: Freddie would always say, I'm going to make a record with you... Freddie got the band together. And we rehearsed it up and through... I remember rehearsing at Freddie's hand.

ctx.x: Well, Freddie. Well, I think Freddie had more stuff than Joe.

But Joe was most of us more of a style. And Louis still is a blue chord man. And he was a blues artist chord. And a hot chord man. But Freddie was great on breaks. He was great on... I had some kind of a new sort of... He could blue also and some of the other things he could do. Now, another thing Freddie kept with you. I don't know whether it's on the record or not. They sent for Tim Brown. Sent for the farm at the... Oh... Coconut Grove in New York. Had a big band. And the rich, the millionaires came to his…
